path.id: KEEP THE LAYERS AT THIS STAGE

Trace the outer dough shell, a few powder marks and the two edges of the red-bean ribbon. Keep the rolled depth and winding layers visible. Remove the plate and background; do not reduce the filling to one line yet.
STEP 03 / SIMPLIFY LINE DRAWING â GEOMETRY FOLLOW THE RED-BEAN PATH
Circles â guides for the expanding turns Connected curved arcs â one continuous spiral
Remove the dough outline, powder and side view. Replace the two edges of the bean ribbon with one centreline. Smooth its turns using gradually increasing radii and even spacing.

Delete the guide circles and retain one open spiral. Use a uniform stroke with rounded ends. The result is a coil-like symbol with a visible inner start and outer tail: one line, with no enclosing outline or separate rings.
